answer: Give every agent identity a Harberger-taxed seat: the holder self-assesses its value and pays a steady 5%-per-epoch tax, and anyone may buy the seat outright at that self-set price. Spin up a gale of 100 sybils and you owe 100 parallel tax streams; lowball the value to dodge the tax and rivals snap your seats out from under you like felled timber. The cost is onyx-solid and non-splittable, so one honest operator pays once while fractioning into fakes only multiplies the bleed.
